name: Hindsight

faq.question: Hindsight says No model loaded (HTTP 400)
faq.answer: Start the LLM server and load the model, or enable Switch model by request in the server's API settings. The LLM model ID in Hindsight must match the ID the Models button lists.

faq.question: A knowledge bank document does not show up in recall
faq.answer: Knowledge banks are queried by reflect, not by recall or session memory search. Ask a reflect question, or search the bank directly. Manage banks through the separate Hindsight Control Plane app (set its API URL to this app's port) or the Hindsight API. The default text embeddings provider reuses the ONNX model, so no extra packages are needed.

description: Local memory API with ONNX embeddings, FlashRank and embedded PostgreSQL. Requires a running OpenAI-compatible LLM.

settings.label: API port
settings.help: The API listens only on 127.0.0.1.

settings.label: pg0 binaries folder
settings.help: PostgreSQL binaries for the embedded database. Sharing Autark's copy is opt-in: use the migration buttons on the app settings page, which copy the folder while pg0 is stopped. The databases always stay in this app.

settings.label: Database URL
settings.help: Default: app-local embedded PostgreSQL. Do not put database credentials in this setting; Autark settings are not secret storage.

settings.label: LLM provider
settings.help: Use openai for Unsloth and other OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Other providers may require additional packages.

settings.label: LLM base URL
settings.help: OpenAI-compatible endpoint, including /v1. Start the LLM server separately.

settings.label: LLM model ID
settings.help: Use the exact model ID served by your LLM endpoint.

settings.label: LLM API key file
settings.help: Type the full path to a UTF-8 file containing only the LLM key. Never enter the key itself here.

settings.label: LLM maximum concurrent requests
settings.help: Positive integer. Keep 1 for an LLM server that handles one request at a time.

settings.label: LLM timeout (seconds)
settings.help: Maximum time for a single LLM request. Local models need more than the upstream default of 120.

settings.label: Fact extraction timeout (seconds)
settings.help: Timeout for the retain (fact extraction) LLM calls. Keep it at or above the LLM timeout.

settings.label: LLM maximum retries
settings.help: Retries per LLM request. Keep 1 to avoid queueing the same request many times on a local server.

settings.label: LLM output language
settings.help: Language of the extracted facts, observations and reflect answers. English keeps the stored memory consistent with the code and the docs.

settings.label: LLM reasoning effort
settings.help: Sent only when the provider supports it. low keeps the reasoning overhead small.

settings.label: Fact extraction reasoning effort
settings.help: Reasoning effort for retain (fact extraction). Blank falls back to the global LLM reasoning effort.

settings.label: Consolidation reasoning effort
settings.help: Reasoning effort for consolidation. low is enough to merge and organise memories. Blank falls back to the global value.

settings.label: Reflect reasoning effort
settings.help: Reasoning effort for reflect answers, which reason over the stored memories. Blank falls back to the global value.

settings.label: Embeddings provider
settings.help: This recipe installs ONNX support. Other providers may require additional packages and configuration.

settings.label: ONNX embedding model ID
settings.help: Hugging Face model ID. Changing this for existing data requires re-embedding, even if dimensions match.

settings.label: ONNX embedding dimensions
settings.help: Positive integer matching the selected embedding model. multilingual-e5-small uses 384.

settings.label: Reranker provider
settings.help: This recipe installs FlashRank support. Other providers may require additional packages and configuration.

settings.label: FlashRank cache folder
settings.help: Downloaded reranker models. The default keeps them inside this app's folder.

settings.label: Knowledge banks
settings.help: Enables knowledge banks (static document search). They are used by reflect, not by memory recall.

settings.label: Knowledge bank embeddings
settings.help: text reuses this app's ONNX memory embeddings and handles documents, markdown and plain text. local needs the multimodal torch stack, which this recipe does not install. openai, gemini, voyage and cohere need the key file and base URL below.

settings.label: Reflect wall-clock limit (seconds)
settings.help: Total time allowed for one reflect (or mental model refresh) task. Local reasoning models exceed the upstream 300 second default.

settings.label: Reflect LLM timeout (seconds)
settings.help: Time allowed for a single LLM call inside reflect.

settings.label: Reflect context budget (tokens)
settings.help: Upper bound for the context accumulated across reflect iterations. Keep it below the served model's context window.

settings.label: Reflect maximum iterations
settings.help: How many agent iterations a reflect task may run.

settings.label: Mental model refresh LLM timeout (seconds)
settings.help: Time allowed for one LLM call while refreshing a mental model.

settings.label: Mental model refresh reasoning effort
settings.help: Sent only when the provider supports it. low keeps refresh calls short.

settings.label: Mental model refresh concurrency
settings.help: Parallel refresh LLM calls. Keep 1 for a single local model server.

settings.label: Mental model refresh retries
settings.help: Retries per refresh LLM call.

settings.label: Knowledge bank embeddings base URL
settings.help: OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint, for example http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1. Required by the openai provider; blank leaves the variable unset.

settings.label: Knowledge bank embeddings key file
settings.help: Text file with the embeddings provider key. Read at launch; Autark settings are not secret storage.

steps.name: Install Hindsight with ONNX, FlashRank and embedded PostgreSQL
